## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `901e99ed1317f46b05411bc3fc65db7c8e77921f`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/landing-operations.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/project-forms.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md + scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs (MAILBOX_KEYS, the field readers, the both-ways self-test pin against 〈信箱 PR〉, `--mailbox-keys`), scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs (H72, its sweep wiring, summary clause and battery), scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs (MAILBOX_LABEL, `seatKey`, the mailbox body text) — the rule and the reader that enforces it, read as one change

Written 2026-11-01T15:22Z by the at-tier subagent of `domain:skills#2`. Inputs = card #28675 (body + 4 comments), PR #28716 (body, file list, the net diff of `901e99ed` over its stacked base `claude/issue-28642-seat-patrol@8eb102ff`, i.e. PR #28687 whose records 6558991413 + 6559169512 stand on their own), and the check-runs on `901e99ed`. The dev's report (6559765410) and the PR body were read as claims and checked against the tree, never adopted. ⛔ #28687's own hunks are not re-judged here.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Published accept set / public surface: unchanged — right.** The delta touches four `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/**` files (governed rules text) and three `scripts/pm/*.mjs` PM tools (not a package, not in `GOVERNED_SURFACES`). No `packages/**`, no `exports` map, no `.d.ts`, no error code. `Clause-②: no` on the PR body and on the claim (6559235791) is the correct declaration.
- **Review face: rules, CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER — right.** `reviewFace --paths` on the PR's file list returns the four references files as `hits`; the three scripts are cited code and are listed on `Scope:` as such.
- **Landing tier by the register: Tier S** (SKILL.md:204, AGENTS.md ¶14: `.claude/**` whole tree; `scripts/pm/**` is not a governed path), exactly as 6558991413 ① read the base PR. Triage's "Tier H" on the card is a card-level condition — the maintainer's approval of the PR is the ruling for the rule change — and the claim and PR body accept it; see ③.
- **Rules text: four files, net 0 lines each (101/54/96/88 at the base and at head); every edited line measured ≤ 120 bytes** (L80 108; project-forms L37–L49 90–120; seat-lifecycle L41/L42/L89 119/117/117; seat-post-protocol L18 116); `SKILL.md` untouched, as the claim's line budget stated. `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `pm-skill-id-lint`, `skill-frame-sync` and `pm-governed-prose` ride `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, green on this head.
- **The key table moved from text to code — right, and pinned both ways.** 〈信箱 PR〉 now names 14 keys as `Kind: key` (L40–L46) and points at `record-recognisers.mjs --mailbox-keys` (L49); `MAILBOX_KEYS` holds the 14 full templates with `from`/`to`/`when`; the self-test reads the 〈信箱 PR〉 section and asserts the named set equals the table set and that the section names `--mailbox-keys`. Verified by hand: the section names exactly `Request: contract-review, triage, urgent-triage, main-red` and `Notify: main-red, contract-review, release-blocker, unblocked, ruling, serial, landed, seat-online, seat-offline, split` = the 14 ids in code; `MAILBOX_FIELD_READERS` has a reader per id (the roster case pins `Object.keys(...).length === 14`). The `// dispatch-gates: self-test-reads` marker stays on L77 with the same two paths, which `dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs` pins by line (7573) — the prose after `--` is not pinned, only that it ends on its own line, so the reworded reason is safe.
- **Reader contract: `Notify: seat-online` gains a required `patrol TRIGGER_ID | none` field; the five-field shape is now `unreadable` — right by the rule and disclosed.** `PATROL_REF` hard-codes `trig_…`; that spelling is the live Routine trigger id in `fleet-roster.fixture.json` (6015: `trig_01Ncn…`) and the #28687 battery's `Patrol:` fixtures, so a real `create_trigger` id reads. `grep` over `scripts/`, `.claude/` and `.github/`: no consumer of `readMailboxLine`/`mailboxEvents`/`MAILBOX_KEYS` outside the two files, so no tool composes the old shape.
- **Half-state registry: H72 → `inventory`, emitted from `sweepInto`, report-only — right.** No label, title, body, assignee or comment write anywhere in the added code. Request cost traced: population = `seenPrs` filled from `/pulls?state=open` (mailbox drafts are in that listing; `LEDGER_EXCLUSION` is a search-query string and does not touch it), cut by `h72NeedsThread` to `pm:mailbox` rows with `updated_at` inside 24 h; then one `since`-bounded comment page per touched mailbox, ≤ 3 pages, incomplete window left UNJUDGED; a failed lazy import renders `NOT MEASURED`, never `0 of N`. The H72 block sits after the `listOpenPullRequests` loop, so `seenPrs` is full when it runs; the dynamic import is reached only after awaited REST calls, so the module has finished evaluating (the banner's deadlock arm). The `seatWindowAudit` pin "every other comment read names its page" moves 3 → 4 because the new path carries `&page=` — raised, not weakened.
- **Self-test rosters:** `record-recognisers` doorbell battery pin 27 → 40 under 44 cases; `check-half-states` gains `H72 mailbox off-table bells` pinned 20 under 22; `mailbox-open` battery updated to the reworded body. `SELF_TEST_BATTERY_FLOOR` untouched.
- **Check-runs on this head at write time: every completed non-skipped run is `success`** — Lint · PM dispatch-gates (the ratchet family and `check:pm-record-recognisers` / `check:pm-half-states`), Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · CI/release/engine, Lint · repo & tooling, ESLint, Type Check ×6, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Live required-set sweep, Platform checklist, Release section-coverage, Test UI, Dogfood, Test Core (2/8), and `Live half-state sweep` — the standing caller of `check-half-states.mjs`, the one run that exercises H72 against the live board, concluded `success` at 2026-11-01T15:21Z (a 12-minute run with the new row in it). Still `in_progress`: `Test Core (1/8)` only, a product shard no path here feeds. No red, no merge-base signature to discount.

### ② Semver level

No publishable package is touched; no changeset exists and the PR carries `skip-changeset` — matches what the diff publishes (nothing). `Clause-②: no` is consistent on the PR body and the claim; no `(narrowing)` arm, so no narrowing face is owed. Correct.

### ③ Boundary flags

Author: `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (relay) — no off-relay login to name.

Dev deviations (report 6559765410 / PR body "Acceptance notes"):
- **`landing-operations.md` L80 `Request: main-red` → `Notify: main-red`** (outside the claim surface) — accepted, and necessary: the old spelling at that line (anchor filer → owning lane's mailbox) is the direction the table now spells as `Notify: main-red`; left as `Request:` it would read as a triage-bound key sent to a lane. One line, in the same file family, declared.
- **`mailbox-open.mjs` "seven doorbell keys" → "doorbell keys" + `--mailbox-keys`** (outside the claim surface) — accepted: the text the opener writes into every new mailbox body would have been false the moment this lands; the body battery is updated in step.
- **Templates moved out of the rules text into `MAILBOX_KEYS`** — accepted; this is how the table fits at net 0 lines, and the both-ways pin keeps the text and the reader coupled (see ①).
- **Wanted ③ (epic seats get mailboxes) not built** — accepted as an out-of-scope finding: triage's own evidence on the card (6559611600) shows `seatKey` refuses `epic:` spellings and adds `mailbox-open.mjs` to the card's files; the seat filed #28718 (open, `finding`) and answered on the card (6559792075).
- **Sender of `Notify: main-red` is "立锚卡者", not "triage" as the card's proposed row said** — accepted: by main-red 约定① (landing-operations L76) the seat that sees the red files the anchor, triage or not, so the filer is the one who knows the breaking PR at that moment. Not listed as a deviation by the dev; noted here so the maintainer sees it.

`out_of_scope_findings`:
- **Epic seats cannot be rung** — #28718, see above.
- **Frozen `dispatch-gates.data.mjs` L505 / `dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs` L7570 comments still say "seven"** — accepted: comment-only, nothing reads them (the census pins `record-recognisers.mjs:77 self-test-reads` by line and that the reason ends on its line, not the word "seven"); instrument-discipline L10 freezes that file.
- **Transition noise: pre-landing five-field `seat-online` lines read `unreadable` for ~24 h after landing** — accepted as a report-only reading (H72 writes nothing; the rows age out). Seats on the old text re-read on the next round's touch-sha check (seat-lifecycle L16–17).

`seat_decides`:
- **`Fixes #28675` with Wanted ③ unbuilt** — answered: acceptable because the remainder has its own open card (#28718) and the card thread records the pointer; the seat's terminal `## 席位核对` on the PR should cite #28718 so the maintainer approving this PR sees where ③ lives (the PR body's acceptance note does not name it yet).
- **File the epic-mailbox finding** — done (#28718).

Open escalations to the maintainer (the approval is the ruling):
- **Instrument-discipline L9 (a new patrol row needs the maintainer's words on the card):** the card quotes the maintainer verbatim (「感觉车道之间还是不太知道使用 邮箱沟通，综合评估一下哪些场景应该沟通，需要的话立skills 卡」) and its Wanted ⑤ asks for the half-state row in so many words; whether that sentence authorises H72 is the maintainer's call, exactly as 6558991413 escalated H70/H71. H72 costs ≤ 3 GETs per touched mailbox and writes nothing. Until approved the PR stays draft, as it is.
- **Tier S by the register with triage's card-level condition:** this record is the Tier S record of record; the owning seat does not flip ready or enqueue before (a) the maintainer's approval is on the PR, (b) #28687 has landed and `origin/main` is merged in (the PR body says so), and (c) `Live half-state sweep` on the then-current head is green.

### ④ Design judgment

Scenario accepted against: the card's measured day — seven invented off-table keys (`surface` ×5, `serial`, `landed`, `ruling`, `take`, reverse `main-red`, `main-red cleared`), zero uses ever of the three `Request:` keys, a p1 card (#28560) waiting 4.5 h after its blocker closed, a main-red anchor (#28622) whose breaking lane was never rung, release blockers (#28546, #28657) learned on patrol, the first free-form question to triage on #28646, and a hand-off line (#28650) with no doorbell.

**`project-forms.md` 〈信箱 PR〉 L37–L49 — holds.** Each measured event now has a row and a key, every invented spelling either gets admitted (`serial`, `landed`, `ruling`) or has a table home (`surface` → `serial`, `take` → `split`, reverse `main-red` → `Notify: main-red`), and `main-red cleared` is deliberately not admitted (the anchor's close is on the card the receiver was rung about) — the doorbell battery pins that those three stay refused/unreadable. The closed-vocabulary line, 200-byte cap, keys-and-numbers-only, ≤ 5/round with p0 exempt, 「永非授权」 and the no-gate line all survive; the dropped 「本席复审档不可用,一 head 一次」 is carried by contract-review.md L21–22 (the hand-off line exists only when the tier was refused) plus the no-re-send row. Read against the reader: `Request: triage` reads card + free question (comma allowed); `Notify: unblocked` admits `p0|p1` only and the template's own `p0 or p1` is unreadable; `Notify: ruling` admits a primed or CJK letter and refuses a sentence; `Notify: serial · #a behind #b` / `Notify: landed · #b` pair; every template sent verbatim is unreadable, so a placeholder can never pass as an event. I tried to break the both-ways pin: it reads only the 〈信箱 PR〉 section (split on `\n## `), so L80 of landing-operations naming `Notify: main-red` neither adds nor is required; a key named only in prose outside the section would go unpinned, but no such key exists at head.
- **should-fix (cap vs. MUST):** L39 makes every listed event 必敲 and L48 keeps 「每席每轮 ≤5 条,p0 豁免」. A triage round that grades three p1 release blockers and unblocks three p1 cards owes six mandatory bells and may send five. Say which wins in one clause (e.g. 「超额归下轮」, or exempt p0/p1 both); today the text contradicts itself at p1.
- **should-fix (`Notify: main-red` with no breaking PR):** the template requires `breaking PR #m`, yet landing-operations L79 admits a maintainer's direct one-line fix and 约定① a revert of "the commit between last green and first red" — a red introduced without a PR has no `#m`, and the mandatory row then cannot be spelled at all. Either give the field a `none` arm in the reader or scope the row to "when the breaking PR is known".

**`seat-lifecycle.md` L41–L42, L89 — holds.** Seating is one stroke: routine + mailbox open/subscribe + `Patrol:`/`Mailbox:` on the stub + `seat-online`; sign-off is the mirror (delete routine, close mailbox, `seat-offline`), consistent with seat-post-protocol L54 step 9 and SKILL.md:75 (換账号重开该席与信箱). The `seat-online` key now carries the patrol trigger, which closes the half 6558991413 ③ left to this card. L89 makes the mailbox read a per-round patrol step (Wanted ④), so a lost delivery is seen within a round.
- **should-fix (order against SKILL.md:73):** L89 reads 「巡查每轮先读信箱、认领到 batch 上限」 while SKILL.md:73 says the fire's FIRST action is the cheapest lane-inventory probe and nothing is read before it. The mailbox page is small, but "先读信箱" as written contradicts 探针先行. One word fixes it: 「探针后先读信箱」 (or 「认领前读信箱」).

**`seat-post-protocol.md` L18 — holds, with one gap.** The stub gains `Mailbox:` beside `Patrol:`; L66 spells `Patrol: TRIGGER_ID · CRON` as the one home of that value.
- **should-fix (`Mailbox:` spelling):** nothing in the rules text or the tooling spells the `Mailbox:` value (`Mailbox: #n`? `PR #n`?), and no reader reads it — the only machine-read copy of the number is the `mailbox #m` field of `seat-online`. The #28687 battery fixture happens to write `- **Mailbox:** PR #28676`. Spell it on L66 next to `Patrol:` (「`Mailbox: PR #n`」) so a future roster reader (#28718's alternative "a `Mailbox:` line the roster reads") has one spelling to read.

**`landing-operations.md` L80 — holds.** The anchor filer rings the owning lane with `Notify: main-red`, the direction the table spells; the same line's 「根因卡恒归该车道」 is unchanged. (The no-PR arm is the should-fix above, owed on the key, not on this line.)

**Cited reader `record-recognisers.mjs` (read, not reviewed):** `readMailboxLine` still strips one signature line, demands a `To: SEAT` line via `seatKey`, refuses an off-table word before the byte cap, and routes the field reading through `MAILBOX_FIELD_READERS[entry.id]`; the new readers are strict on part count and regex per field, and `numbers` lists every card/PR a line names. `mailboxKeyLines()` is pure and the CLI arm prints it at exit 0. The doorbell battery drives every new key, the `patrol none` arm, the five-field refusal, the invented keys and the end-to-end H72 leg through a real `mailboxEvents` reading.

**Cited gate `check-half-states.mjs` H72 (read, not reviewed):** scope traced in ①; the predicate lists `refused` and `unreadable` events younger than 24 h (an unreadable `at` is kept, not aged out), names ≤ 5 comments with id/author/state/reason, sanitises angle-bracket placeholders out of the body, and the sentence carries the 〈信箱 PR〉 remedy, the `--mailbox-keys` pointer, the no-re-send and never-an-authorization lines and the report-only boundary. I tried to break it: a mailbox whose comment page fails is skipped and counted short, not read clean; a reader that fails to import renders NOT MEASURED; a quiet mailbox costs no request; GitHub's `since` filters by comment `updated_at`, so an old comment edited today is fetched but then aged out by its `created_at` — correct. One accepted limitation: any non-doorbell comment a bot might leave on a mailbox PR would be listed; the dev's live probe found only seat-written lines.

No must-fix: the table holds against every event the card measured, the reader and the text cannot drift (the pin is bidirectional and gated), the new row writes nothing and costs what it says, and every rule line is at or under 120 bytes at net zero.

Reviewed-by: `session_017ihL2g7RyXa8ErM6GAkHyc`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `37661b885bac64fd4d09ed0c922d7504fc0d1577`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/landing-operations.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/project-forms.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md + scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs (MAILBOX_KEYS, `BREAKING_REF`, the `notify:main-red` reader and its new case), scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs and scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs (unchanged on this head; their readings in 6559915023 carry over)

Delta review, written 2026-11-01T15:40Z by the same at-tier subagent that rendered record 6559915023 on the previous head `901e99ed`. The head moved by ONE commit (`37661b88`, "mailbox patch round"): 12+/8− across `project-forms.md` L48–L49, `seat-lifecycle.md` L89, `seat-post-protocol.md` L66 and `record-recognisers.mjs`; `landing-operations.md`, `check-half-states.mjs` and `mailbox-open.mjs` are byte-identical to the previous head. The ① ② ③ ④ judgments of 6559915023 carry over unchanged except where this record says otherwise. Inputs = that diff, the card thread (no new comment since), the PR body, and the check-runs on `37661b88`.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept set / public surface: still unchanged — right.** Three governed rules files and one PM tool; no package, no changeset, `skip-changeset` still on the PR, `Clause-②: no` unchanged.
- **The delta applies the four should-fixes of 6559915023 and nothing else — right, verified against the diff:** (1) project-forms L48 gains 「超额归下轮」 beside 「≤5 条,p0 豁免」 — the cap and the MUST rows no longer contradict at p1; the two closing lines were re-cut so L48 carries cap + `--mailbox-keys` and L49 carries 「永非授权」 + the no-gate line, every clause of the old L48/L49 surviving. (2) `Notify: main-red` template becomes `… · breaking PR #m or none`; `BREAKING_REF` admits `#digits` or the literal `none`; the reader returns `pr: null` and `numbers: [anchor]` on `none`. (3) seat-lifecycle L89 now reads 「巡查每轮探针后读信箱、认领满 batch」 — ordered after SKILL.md:73's probe. (4) seat-post-protocol L66 spells `Mailbox: PR #n` beside `Patrol: TRIGGER_ID · CRON` as the stub's one home for both values; 「放宽须写理由」 survives as 「放宽注由」.
- **Rules text: net 0 lines each (54/96/88/101 unchanged); edited lines measured 115 / 119 / 116 / 120 bytes** — at or under 120. The 〈信箱 PR〉 section still names exactly 14 distinct `Kind: key` spans and still names `--mailbox-keys`, so the both-ways pin holds on this head; the `// dispatch-gates: self-test-reads` marker is untouched.
- **Reader contract:** the new template sent verbatim (`breaking PR #m or none`) matches neither arm of `BREAKING_REF`, so the "every template is not an event" pin still holds; `breaking none`, `breaking PR #0` and `breaking PR` stay unreadable — the new case pins all four. Doorbell battery 44 → 45 cases under the pin of 40.
- **Check-runs on this head: COMPLETE, every non-skipped run `success`, none in progress** — Lint · PM dispatch-gates (ratchet / id-lint / frame-sync / `check:pm-record-recognisers` / `check:pm-half-states`), Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · CI/release/engine, Lint · repo & tooling, ESLint, Type Check ×6, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Check PR Size, Live required-set sweep, `Live half-state sweep` (H72 against the live board, done 2026-11-01T15:35Z), Platform checklist, Release section-coverage, Test UI, Dogfood, Test Core (1/8), (2/8) and the aggregate. No red, no merge-base signature to discount.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged from 6559915023: no publishable package touched, no changeset, `skip-changeset` on the PR, `Clause-②: no` on body and claim, no narrowing arm. Correct.

### ③ Boundary flags

- No new dev flag, no new `open_questions`, no new comment on the card since 6559915023. The answers given there stand: Wanted ③ lives on #28718; `Fixes #28675` accepted with the ask that the seat's `## 席位核对` cite #28718; the two escalations (instrument-discipline L9 authorisation of H72, and Tier S by the register under triage's card-level condition that the maintainer's approval is the ruling) remain with the maintainer. The PR is still draft, as it should be, and still owes #28687's landing plus an `origin/main` merge before it goes ready.
- **PR body is stale on two points (noted, not a condition on the tree):** its "Recorded exit codes" list and gate counts were derived at `901e99ed`, not re-derived on this commit, and its `--mailbox-keys` printout still shows `Notify: main-red · anchor #n · breaking PR #m` without the `or none` arm. Both are the seat's to refresh when it writes its terminal `## 席位核对`; the check-runs on `37661b88` are the gate verdicts this record relies on.
- Author: `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (relay) — no off-relay login to name.

### ④ Design judgment

The four `hits` files on this head hold as 6559915023 ④ judged them, with the four should-fixes closed:

**`project-forms.md` L48 — holds.** 「超额归下轮」 resolves cap-versus-MUST without widening the exemption: a p1 bell the cap defers is still owed, next round, and the no-re-send row is untouched because deferral is not a re-send. I tried to break it: a seat could read 「归下轮」 as permission to never ring — but L39's 必敲 still binds the event and H72 does not read silence, so the only reading that satisfies both lines is "ring it next round"; good enough for a rules line at 115 bytes.

**`Notify: main-red … breaking PR #m or none` — holds.** The red with no PR (landing-operations L79's maintainer direct fix, 约定①'s revert window) can now be rung; `pr: null` keeps `numbers` honest (the anchor alone), so a reader that fans out on `numbers` never chases a PR #0. `none` is the same spelling the list fields already use (`takes: none`), one vocabulary.

**`seat-lifecycle.md` L89 — holds.** 「探针后读信箱」 orders the mailbox read after SKILL.md:73's cheapest-probe-first and before claiming, which is where a delivered bell (an `unblocked`, a `serial`) can still change what the seat claims this round.

**`seat-post-protocol.md` L66 — holds.** `Mailbox: PR #n` is now spelled where `Patrol:` is, matching the #28687 H70 fixture (`- **Mailbox:** PR #28676`) and the `mailbox #m` field of `seat-online`; a future roster reader has one spelling to read.

**Cited reader (read, not reviewed):** the `notify:main-red` reader still demands exactly three parts, and the `none` arm cannot be reached through the `#m` capture, so a well-formed numeric line reads exactly as before (the existing DB.nm case still passes). No must-fix, no new should-fix.

## 维护者速读(席位终稿 · head `37661b885bac64fd4d09ed0c922d7504fc0d1577`)

- **改了什么**:〈信箱 PR〉改成一张「什么事必须敲谁的门、用哪个键」的场景表(含不许敲的情形);键从 7 个扩到 14 个(收编车道自造的 `serial`/`landed`/`ruling`,新增 `Request: triage`、`Notify: unblocked`/`release-blocker`/反向 `main-red`);`seat-online` 带上巡查任务号;坐席同一动作开信箱并订阅,存根记 `Mailbox: PR #n`,收班关掉;巡查每轮探针后先读信箱;键的全文模板搬进 `record-recognisers.mjs --mailbox-keys`,规则文本与代码双向钉死;半状态巡检新增 H72(只读):列出近 24 小时表外或读不懂的信箱消息。
